in_marathi.name: Latu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Latu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Latu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'lat' meaning 'sun' and 'u' meaning 'ray'. In Hindu mythology, Latu is a name for the sun god, Surya, and his rays. It is also a name for the Sun deity's horse, Suryaksha.
